panels.title: Measured outcomes
panels.description: Comparison timing/token panels exclude warm-up and fallback. Error rate counts fallback as failure. Process-local guardrail; missing samples are not zero.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, experiment, variant, outcome) (rate(llm_gateway_experiment_result_total[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Error + fallback rate
panels.description: Comparison timing/token panels exclude warm-up and fallback. Error rate counts fallback as failure. Process-local guardrail; missing samples are not zero.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, experiment, variant) (rate(llm_gateway_experiment_result_total{outcome=~"error|fallback"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (job, instance, experiment, variant) (rate(llm_gateway_experiment_result_total{outcome=~"success|error|fallback"}[$__rate_interval]))
